Night over the old city, a thunderstorm far away, one window flickers with strange red light.
Theo asleep in his messy bedroom full of comics, tossing and turning, a dark red glow under his bed.
In the archive a dark red jar on a high shelf cracks, black smoke and red light leaking out.
Mira runs through the rainy night street with her lantern toward Theo's house.
Inside Theo's room the walls stretch tall and dark, giant shadows of crows flap across the ceiling, Theo awake hiding under his blanket.
Huge shadow crows swirl around the room, papers flying, the lamp flickering.
The silver light in the lantern grows warm and soft like a nightlight.
The giant shadow crows shrink into small harmless sparrows made of soft grey light, chirping.
The little sparrows of light fly into a small glass jar that Mira holds open, the jar glows calm blue.
Outside Theo's window, on the rainy rooftop across, the tall shadow in the hat watches, then turns away.
Dawn, the star fades, the lantern glows on the windowsill.
